caption: A rubber balloon inflates steadily until it bursts, leaving deflated fragments in place.

clauses.text: The balloon must be connected to a source of air pressure capable of inflating it.
The balloon must visibly expand gradually as air enters, increasing in size and tautness.
The balloon must reach a point of rupture where it bursts suddenly, releasing air and leaving torn remnants attached to the inflation nozzle.
The deflated fragments must remain in place on the nozzle after the burst, without being displaced or removed.
